meaning:
συλαγωγέω, -ῶ
(σύλη, booty + ἄγω),
to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, Col.2:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after…
